concept.title: Local area residents
concept.shortdesc: People living in a named local area such as North Lincolnshire or Dorset, or the whole local community with no particular group singled out.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : People, families and library members living in North Lincolnshire and nearby Lincolnshire areas.
: People living in Dorset or a named part of Dorset, including by postcode area.
: The whole local community, including villagers and community members, with no particular group singled out.
